messages:
Nora (partner-lead): Partner reported a regression when moving to CUDA 12.0 in our marketplace image. They want a clear hotfix + rollback + announcement flow. Can we draft a short on-call playbook?

Kunal (hw-eng): For hardware regressions we need: failing run command, driver package + SHA256, kernel oops logs, and a minimal repro. Prefer tarball uploaded to `s3://redwood-partner-hotfixes/partnerX/`.

Jade (solutions): We can add `compat_fallback` and `driver_pin` fields to the marketplace manifest and a runtime flag to prefer pinned images when health checks fail. I'll mock a manifest snippet and CI job.

Omar (platform): Platform will do canary rollout: 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Automatic pause if error rate >1.5% or p95 latency +20%. We'll export canary logs to `s3://redwood-canaries/cuda12/` and notify partners. Deploy-bot: please schedule a sync.

deploy-bot: Event: Hotfix coordination call scheduled 2026-06-02 16:00 UTC  https://calendar.redwood.ai/ev/88888

Nora (partner-lead): Partners insist on signed manifests (GPG) and a phone-tree for SEV1. Also want an option to opt into a `legacy-driver` tag while they verify.

Kunal (hw-eng): We'll validate on three SKUs; need image by May 28. Fallback image pinned to `driver-530.30` ready.

Jade (solutions): Sample runtime override: `REDWOOD_DRIVER_PIN=530.30 REDWOOD_RUNTIME_FALLBACK=true --image=redwood/marketplace:cuda12-canary`. CI: `pipeline: driver_compat_smoke`.

Omar (platform): Ops checklist: require green `kernel-smoke` and `perf-smoke` before promoting to soft-deprecate. Retain canary traces 72h; add partner contact to alerts. We'll tag runs that used fallback with `using-compat-fallback`.

Nora (partner-lead): I'll draft the one-pager + escalation tree and share before the call. If nobody objects we'll send announcement draft to partners after validation. :thumbsup:
